notes.title: SPYCITY Update v0.1c
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.1c now released![/h1]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
- Fixed a network error that caused the game to restart when disconnected.
- Fixed double click sound on "Join" button.
- Fixed formatting of some texts after localization update.
- Fixed that some texts localization updates only after second start.
- Fixed camera error when joining on game in finish state.

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
- Changed font size in Update Log.
- Changed roles random generator.
- Agents now see all tasks on map to prevent camping.

[h3]Special thanks to:[/h3]
[b]Parasitical & Blackyyzz[/b] for improving the translation into Polish.
[b]Tristan & John[/b] for bug reports.

notes.title: SPYCITY Update v0.1b
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.1b now released![/h1]

We have started to add support for other languages, you can change the language in the game settings in the Steam library.

[b]At the moment, we have included the following languages in support:[/b]

[i]English, German, French, Italian, Korean, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified), Russian, Thai, Japanese, Portuguese, Polish, Danish, Czech, Turkish, Greek and Ukrainian.[/i]

Unfortunately, the translation may not be accurate in many points, if you want to help us, then go to the website to contact us.

Website: https://spycity.shibogames.com

[i]P.S.: Anyone who helps with the translation will be added to the next Update Log as a special thank you.[/i]

notes.title: SPYCITY Update v0.1a
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.1a now released![/h1]
- Tasks on the map are now hidden from agents if there are less than 3 tasks left.
- Temporary disabled Map Toggle from Lobby Settings.
- Fixed tasks count text not updated at client side on Game Start.
- Added task object to Playground task.
